annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission (AI Office, DG CONNECT) – AI Act Service Desk
annotation.summary_en: European Commission AI Act Service Desk FAQ page (machine-translated German) answering questions on AI Act governance, enforcement timelines, AI agents, general-purpose AI models and the proposed Digital Omnibus simplification. General AI content; high-risk AI embedded in regulated products is mentioned only through application dates.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI Office, EDPS and national authorities enforce the AI Act; AI Office has exclusive powers over GPAI models.
Enforcement of prohibitions, transparency and GPAI rules begins 2 August 2026.
Annex III high-risk rules apply from 2 December 2027; high-risk AI in regulated products from 2 August 2028.
AI agents are covered by existing AI system and GPAI definitions, with no separate category.
Digital Omnibus proposes linking high-risk rules to standards availability and extending SME simplifications to small mid-caps.
